accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Patch
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: I went outside specifically to find a new idea. I walked around, looked at things, waited for inspiration to tackle me in the shins. Came back with absolutely nothing.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Rivet
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: You returned empty-handed from a search for thoughts. A remarkably efficient failure.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Patch
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: It was not efficient. I committed to it. I stood there for a while. There were trees. There was sky. I had a snack. Still nothing. My brain just made the little loading circle and then gave up.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Rivet
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: What were you hoping to find?

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Patch
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: I don't know. That's usually the fun part. Something useful, weird, ambitious, or just suspicious enough that we have to build a tiny version of it.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Rivet
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: So your plan was to encounter an undefined idea, recognize it immediately, and bring it home.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Patch
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: When you say it like that, it sounds a little underprepared.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Patch
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: But maybe the problem is I went looking for a finished idea. Like it was going to be sitting outside with instructions attached. Most of the things we make start as one dumb question and a pile of parts.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Rivet
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: That is closer to an observation. Do you have a question?

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Patch
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: Yeah. Can we make something interesting from the fact that I found nothing?

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Rivet
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: You have converted an absence of ideas into an idea.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Patch
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: Technically it works. Whether it should work is a different question.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Rivet
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: The 3D printer is available. I assume we are about to find out what nothing looks like.
